tested_scope: One bounded official-repository immutable-tree audit for committed UTF-8 evidence-package components only: realized input/config, ordered execution/output rows, evaluator decisions, and result/paper bindings.

public_sources.observation: refs/heads/main resolved to d9017d90e329112d2a80b7712f37ee9094d2cd27 at audit time.

The complete recursive tree was returned with truncated=false. It contains source files plus experiment_configs/MATH_agentlab.yaml and experiment_configs/MATH_agentrxiv.yaml, but no committed state_saves/, research_dir/, papers output tree, run-log/result JSONL layer, ordered execution transcript, evaluator-decision artifact, or result-to-paper provenance manifest.
The checked revision ignores state*, state_saves/*, papers*, junk/logs, and research_dir/*, placing several realized-state/output classes outside the committed tree by default.

Official repository README surface describes an end-to-end research workflow and runtime checkpoint loading from state_saves, with LLM backends such as OpenAI and DeepSeek; this was used only to select the candidate and interpret the ignored runtime-state path, not to infer an unobserved historical run.

observations: A committed experiment-configuration layer exists at the tested immutable revision.
The complete committed tree does not expose realized run-state/output/evaluator/paper-binding artifact layers required by the current static replay gate.
The repository ignore policy explicitly excludes state and output-like paths including state_saves, papers, junk/logs, and research_dir.
inference: For this exact revision and committed-tree surface, Agent Laboratory cannot supply a Chat-only static historical-run replay package that binds configured experiment intent to realized ordered execution/output rows, evaluator decisions, and final paper/result artifacts. Runtime checkpointing is useful operationally but is not equivalent to a committed evidence package.
uncertainty_and_scope_guard: This does not prove that no external, release, fork, local, historical, or separately hosted Agent Laboratory run artifacts exist.
This does not claim the system cannot reproduce results dynamically; it only fails the tested committed static-evidence package criterion.
No inference is made from absent filenames beyond the complete tree at revision d9017d90e329112d2a80b7712f37ee9094d2cd27 and the explicit ignore rules.

phase1_assessment.reason: Closing the useful outcome from this tested package would require executing the workflow or obtaining an additional realized-run artifact package not present in the committed tree.
phase1_assessment.quota_scope: The documented dynamic workflow uses external LLM/API backends; that dynamic route therefore cannot be accepted under the zero-finite-quota rule. This does not imply that repository text transport itself consumes such quota.
phase1_assessment.cost_scope: This bounded static audit used only public/repository text reads and added no monetary execution cost.
